title: Data Structures TA
description: Assist professor with grading assignments, tutoring students, and conducting lab sessions. Responsibilities include: grading weekly assignments and exams, holding office hours, leading lab sessions, and helping students debug code. Work schedule: Monday 2-4pm, Wednesday 3-5pm, Friday 10am-12pm (6 hours per week), plus flexible hours for grading.
requirements: Proficient in C/C++ programming, strong understanding of data structures (arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs), ability to explain complex concepts clearly, previous tutoring or TA experience preferred. Required availability: Monday 2-4pm, Wednesday 3-5pm, Friday 10am-12pm.

title: Database TA
description: Maintain and support the database lab environment. Responsibilities include: setting up lab machines, troubleshooting database issues, assisting students with SQL queries and database design, maintaining lab documentation, and conducting weekly lab sessions. Work schedule: Tuesday 1-3pm, Thursday 2-4pm (4 hours per week), plus on-call support for lab emergencies.
requirements: Proficient in SQL and relational database design, experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL, understanding of database normalization and indexing, ability to troubleshoot database connectivity issues, good communication skills. Required availability: Tuesday 1-3pm, Thursday 2-4pm.

title: Software Engineering TA
description: Assist with project evaluation and code review. Responsibilities include: reviewing student project code for quality and design patterns, providing constructive feedback, grading projects, conducting code review sessions, and mentoring students on best practices. Work schedule: Monday 10am-12pm, Wednesday 1-3pm, Friday 2-4pm (6 hours per week), plus flexible time for code reviews.
requirements: Software development experience (at least 2 years), proficiency in Java or Python, understanding of design patterns and software architecture, experience with version control (Git), ability to provide constructive code feedback. Required availability: Monday 10am-12pm, Wednesday 1-3pm, Friday 2-4pm.

title: Product Development TA
description: Assist with product design and user testing. Responsibilities include: conducting user interviews and usability testing, analyzing user feedback, assisting with prototyping, documenting design decisions, and leading design review sessions. Work schedule: Tuesday 10am-1pm, Thursday 1-4pm (6 hours per week), plus flexible hours for user testing sessions.
requirements: Product design experience or strong interest in UX/UI, familiarity with design tools (Figma, Adobe XD), understanding of user research methodologies, ability to conduct user interviews, excellent communication and presentation skills. Required availability: Tuesday 10am-1pm, Thursday 1-4pm.

title: Operating Systems TA
description: Assist with lab guidance and system debugging. Responsibilities include: conducting lab sessions on OS concepts, helping students debug kernel code, maintaining lab environment, assisting with assignment grading, and providing technical support. Work schedule: Monday 1-3pm, Wednesday 10am-12pm, Friday 3-5pm (6 hours per week), plus flexible hours for debugging support.
requirements: Proficient in Linux systems and shell scripting, strong understanding of OS concepts (processes, threads, memory management, file systems), experience with system-level debugging tools, ability to explain complex OS concepts. Required availability: Monday 1-3pm, Wednesday 10am-12pm, Friday 3-5pm.

title: Computer Networks TA
description: Assist with network labs and Q&A sessions. Responsibilities include: conducting network lab sessions, helping students with network configuration and troubleshooting, grading network assignments, answering student questions about TCP/IP and networking protocols, and maintaining lab equipment. Work schedule: Tuesday 2-4pm, Thursday 10am-12pm (4 hours per week), plus office hours for Q&A.
requirements: Understanding of TCP/IP protocols and network architecture, experience with network simulation tools (Cisco Packet Tracer, GNS3), familiarity with network troubleshooting tools (ping, traceroute, wireshark), ability to explain networking concepts clearly. Required availability: Tuesday 2-4pm, Thursday 10am-12pm.

title: Artificial Intelligence TA
description: Assist with machine learning lab guidance and project support. Responsibilities include: conducting lab sessions on ML algorithms, helping students with Python ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn), reviewing ML projects, grading assignments, and providing guidance on deep learning concepts. Work schedule: Monday 2-5pm, Wednesday 1-4pm, Friday 10am-1pm (9 hours per week), plus flexible hours for project reviews.
requirements: Python programming proficiency, understanding of machine learning fundamentals (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks), experience with deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch), familiarity with data preprocessing and model evaluation, ability to explain complex ML concepts. Required availability: Monday 2-5pm, Wednesday 1-4pm, Friday 10am-1pm.
